basis: Named power invoked in the Greek Magical Papyri (PGM)

entities.name: The Invoked Powers of the Magical Papyri
entities.primary_domains: ritual invocation; binding; revelation; coercion of gods
entities.source: Betz, The Greek Magical Papyri in Translation (PGM), Introduction
entities.note: Umbrella collective for the named gods, daimons and cosmic powers conjured across the Theban magical library (PGM) — a system that drew Greek, Egyptian, Jewish and Mesopotamian powers into one operative magic.

entities.name: The Headless One (Akephalos)
entities.primary_domains: exorcism; creation; supreme authority; coercion of spirits
entities.source: Betz, PGM V.96-172 (Stele of Jeu the hieroglyphist)
entities.note: The Akephalos creator-god of the Stele of Jeu, invoked in PGM V for exorcism and identified with the source of cosmic order.

entities.name: The Kosmokrator (Ruler of the Cosmos)
entities.primary_domains: cosmic rulership; sovereignty over the elements; supreme authority
entities.source: Betz, PGM IV and XIII (the 'kosmokrator' epithet of the supreme god)
entities.note: Kosmokrator ('ruler of the cosmos') is invoked as a title of the supreme magical god commanding the elements and heavenly powers.

entities.name: The Aerial and Chthonic Daimones
entities.primary_domains: intermediary spirits; aerial and underworld powers; assistance; coercion
entities.source: Betz, PGM I and IV (the assistant-daimon and 'daimones of the air and earth')
entities.note: The class of aerial and chthonic daimones invoked collectively in the PGM as intermediary powers and as the practitioner's assistant-spirits (paredroi).

entities.name: Ablanathanalba
entities.source: Betz, PGM (the palindrome ABLANATHANALBA, ubiquitous in protective spells and on amulets)
entities.note: Recurring protective palindrome treated as a named power, frequently paired with Sesengenbarpharanges on PGM amulets.

entities.name: Sesengenbarpharanges
entities.source: Betz, PGM (the name Sesengenbarpharanges in protective and binding spells and on amulets)
entities.note: A recurrent named power in PGM protective and binding formulae, treated as an addressed entity (often with Ablanathanalba).

relationships.rationale: The collective of PGM-invoked powers is the operative pantheon of Greco-Egyptian ritual magic.
The Theban magical library transmits the secret ritual knowledge for compelling these powers.
The Headless One is a major PGM invoked god.
The Stele of Jeu invokes Akephalos for exorcism and protective authority over spirits.
The Akephalos creator-god is addressed as the source of cosmic order in ritual command.
Kosmokrator is a title of the supreme invoked god in the PGM.
The world-ruler title overlaps with the cosmic sovereignty of Aion.
As ruler of the cosmos he is invoked for command and protective authority over powers.
The aerial and chthonic daimones are a standing class of PGM-invoked spirits.
The intermediary daimones are the operative spirits of PGM ritual practice.
These daimones are summoned as assistant-spirits and into mediums in the PGM.
The palindrome is a recurrent named power across the PGM and amulets.
Ablanathanalba is invoked as a protective apotropaic power.
Sesengenbarpharanges is a recurrent named power in PGM protective and binding spells.
The two names co-occur on PGM amulets as a protective pair.
It is invoked for protective and binding effect in PGM formulae.
The Basilidean 365-power Abrasax is among the supreme names invoked across the PGM and on magical gems.
Iao, the vocalized tetragrammaton, is the great magical name recurring throughout the PGM.
Sabaoth ('Lord of Hosts') is a standard PGM name of power, chained with Iao and Adonai.
Adonai occurs in the Iao-Sabaoth-Adonai sequence of PGM invocations.
Aion is invoked as a supreme cosmic power in PGM IV and XIII.
Seth, equated with Typhon, is the principal coercive power of PGM aggressive and curse magic.
Helios is invoked as the all-seeing solar lord and revealer in PGM solar spells.
Ra (as Phre, pa-Ra) is invoked as the sun-god in transliterated solar formulae of the PGM.
Selene heads the composite lunar goddess of the great PGM IV love-and-curse spells.
Hekate is fused into the triple lunar goddess invoked in PGM IV.
The Mesopotamian queen of the dead is invoked as a chthonic lunar name fused with Hekate in PGM lunar spells.
Oracular Bes is invoked to send dream-oracles in the PGM Bes divination spells.
Harpocrates on the lotus is invoked as the newborn sun and protective power in PGM and amuletic magic.
The benevolent serpent-spirit Agathodaimon is invoked as a protective and revealing power in the PGM.
Necessity/Ananke is personified and invoked in the PGM compulsion formulae that force gods to obey.
Pan-the-All is invoked in PGM cosmic hymns through the wordplay Pan = 'the All'.
The Mithras of PGM IV's 'Mithras Liturgy' is invoked as the solar god of a ritual ascent and immortalization rite.
